title: aaj aalam me naqi ka janashee'n paida hua
body:
aaj aalam me naqi ka janashee'n paida hua
mustafa ka gyaarwa masnad nashee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaya roshan naqi ke chand se saara jaha'n
hai taqi masroor pota mehjabee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
shor hai salwat ka ghul hai mubarakbaad ka
qush hai maa aur baap farzande hasee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
quld me masroor hai roohe ali o fatima
murtaza ka aaj daswa jaanashee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
jiska beta hazrate eesa ka hoga peshwa
wo falake qadr aaj baalaae zamee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
terwe (13) masoom ki meelaad ka hai jashn aaj
shaad hai sab mominee'n sultane dee'n paida hua
